Changelog

Changelog

What changed in each Nomi release, newest first.

Versions

v2.3.9 — Custom themes, file preview and editing, per-chat transcript detail

2026-11-10

New

  • Settings → Appearance adds "My themes": pick accent, background, surface and text colors and the rest is derived with contrast fixes; set one for light and one for dark to follow the system, add a background image, and import or export theme packs
  • The file side panel previews and edits documents and source code, with line jumps, an outline and search; in file focus mode the chat folds into a Nomi button at the bottom right, and selected text can be sent with "Ask"
  • Transcript detail: pick a default in Settings (compact / show thinking / detailed) and override it per chat from the title bar; compact folds tool calls of the same kind into one line (#310)
  • The agent board can pause and resume Nomi's background runs: the current turn finishes, then it waits until you resume it
  • When a coding agent's sign-in is rejected with 403, Nomi explains why and can retry with your terminal's proxy; launching from Finder or the Dock now picks up that proxy too
  • Once an update is downloaded, the "Restart to update" button sits at the right of the title bar; updates are checked every 3 hours
  • Menus, session details and the side panel animate in and out (not when Reduce Motion is on)

Fixes

  • Changing a project's folders while a coding agent is running now syncs after the turn, so the next turn uses the new folders (#309)
  • Forking a chat without a project no longer puts the copy into the project of the chat you have open (#308)
  • A coding session's own transcript detail is kept after closing the tab and reopening it from history (#313)
  • Agent board: finished terminal sessions no longer always show "active just now" and hide on time; turning off automatic handling no longer resumes tabs Nomi paused (#316); a tab that kept one session is no longer shown as a terminal session after a restart (#315)
  • Coding agents in the sandbox can read ~/.npmrc (npm mirrors work and nvm stops erroring) but still can't write it; skill scripts without execute permission are run through their interpreter instead of being mistaken for a sandbox block
  • On macOS the desktop character can be dragged right away when it isn't in front; the static character no longer shows up blank when its window is shown again
  • File previews respect protected folders; clicking "…" or "More" again closes the menu

Changes

  • Faster and lighter: the agent board and progress monitor share one process list, reading it no longer spawns a subprocess on macOS and Windows, idle polling is rarer, and long chats and streaming redo far less work

v2.3.8 — Multi-folder projects, one fork dialog

2026-11-09

New

  • A project can hold several folders: one is the primary folder (the working directory; git and AGENTS.md come from it), and Nomi and coding agents can read and write the others too
  • The button on the sidebar's Projects header opens "Create project" instead of starting a chat; a project's "…" menu renames it, adds or removes folders, changes the primary folder, or removes the project (only the entry, never your files)
  • New chats, the new-chat menu and forks let you pick a project; when a project's folders change, existing chats use the new folders from their next turn
  • In the side panel, Changes shows one section per git repository with its own branch, staging and commit; Files shows one node per folder; @ paths in the input cover every folder
  • Forking is one dialog: a new session or another endpoint, how many turns to carry and which project, all in one place
  • Each reply has "Fork from here": it carries messages up to that reply only and leaves later ones out; the original chat is unchanged

Fixes

  • Coding agents in the sandbox can no longer change version-manager command entries (~/.pyenv/shims, rbenv, asdf, mise, Volta…); tool logs and caches stay writable (#302)
  • MiniMax Code tabs on a third-party provider use their own gateway token, so effort, model and usage match the tab, and the old token stops working once the tab closes (#301)
  • On macOS with Rive animation off, the static character no longer shows up blank on first display, after turning it back on or when switching from Rive; no resize needed (#303)

Changes

  • On the first launch after updating, each working directory you used before becomes a project, with its chats still in it
  • The fork turn choices no longer include "last 1 turn"
  • The chat list no longer shifts sideways when its scrollbar appears

v2.3.7 — Kimi Code and MiniMax Code, bulk close on the board, key notes

2026-11-09

New

  • New built-in coding agents Kimi Code and MiniMax Code: install, update and sign in with official accounts (several allowed) in Settings → Coding agents, or use third-party models from Models & Providers (through the Nomi gateway, your own config is untouched); open tabs, switch permission modes, resume sessions, and let Nomi delegate tasks to them
  • Agent board: finished tabs can be closed from the bottom right of their card; idle processes can be selected (or all at once) and closed together, with a reason for each one that could not be closed
  • Each third-party provider key can have a note (which account, balance, expiry…) shown next to the key; it is kept when you replace the key's value
  • Model pickers show the model's or provider's brand icon, and the icons along the input bar share one size and line up with the text

Fixes

  • Coding agents dispatched by background Nomi tasks no longer queue until they time out when those tasks fill every running slot (#294)
  • An old approval button on the Dynamic Island no longer acts on the task's next request (#293)
  • Closing an idle coding agent by hand asks you to try again when the process list can't be read, instead of acting on an old list (#295)
  • Under memory pressure the coding agent tab you are looking at is no longer paused (the reply you were waiting for used to hang)
  • Fewer coding agent reminders: several finishing together become one, ones that need you still show right away, and no more duplicate or phantom "done" reminders
  • Fewer sandbox prompts: tools writing logs and caches and package managers' routine reads of ~/.npmrc / ~/.pypirc no longer ask; Kimi Code, MiniMax Code and dsh tabs on third-party providers start normally in the sandbox
  • Coding agents appear in the sidebar as soon as they are installed, no restart needed
  • When a coding agent fails to start, the message names that agent and the reason instead of always saying "Gemini is too old"
  • Coding agent session titles show your first message instead of the sandbox note
  • The model under coding agent messages shows the provider name (like "MAAS · kimi-k3") instead of an internal id
  • Tool calls in Kimi Code tabs show their commands and arguments
  • The Full access button in the input bar drops its red border and fill and keeps only red text

Fixes

  • Clicking Open or an item on the Dynamic Island brings the chat window to the front and jumps to it: tasks open their details, coding agent requests open their tab, and Nomi's confirmations open the main chat; before, it seemed to do nothing when the chat window was already open

v2.3.5 — Redesigned Dynamic Island, Agent board, task board and asset library

2026-11-08

New

  • Redesigned Dynamic Island: a dark capsule with a status badge on the Nomi icon; coding agent permission requests, plan approvals, sandbox blocks and actions Nomi asks you to confirm stay on the island and can be allowed or denied right there, listed when there are several; can be turned off in Settings → Notifications
  • Redesigned Agent board: filter by status and agent type or search, cards show status, source, folder and CPU / memory, and the footer shows Nomi's own usage and what the memory guard did recently
  • New dispatch policy for delegated agents and background tasks combined: Saver (up to 5 at once) / Balanced (10) / Full speed (no limit, gated by CPU and memory), applied immediately
  • Redesigned task board: progress is merged into to do / in progress / needs you / done, with filtering by stage and search, and run now or pause right on the card
  • Redesigned asset library: filter by category, source and search with storage used shown; generated images are categorized automatically and you can change the category and add tags; image details offer full-screen view, previous / next, thumbnails and related images
  • New shortcut "Open project in terminal": ⇧⌘C on macOS, Ctrl+Shift+C on Windows / Linux, configurable in Settings

Improvements

  • Far fewer confirmations in Nomi chats: reading workspace files no longer triggers the external-content confirmation, cards offer "Don't ask again in this conversation", and follow-ups to an approved delegation no longer ask each time
  • Tidier Settings: General uses two side-by-side cards, Archived conversations moves to Nomi, Permissions and Delegation merge into Permissions & delegation; sections without a help column use the full width and controls wrap to the next line in narrow cards
  • Conversation text size is now three steps: Normal, Large (default) and Extra large
  • The theme picker shows one row by default with the rest under "More themes", and the current theme always stays visible
  • A cleaner sidebar header: the Nomi logo is gone and the title bar button expands / collapses the sidebar

Fixes

  • Delegated sub-tasks in session details no longer stay "running" after they finish and errors are shown; Changes counts the workspace's git changes, including those made by delegated coding agents
  • Sessions Nomi dispatched no longer reappear on the Agent board as read-only terminal sessions after their tab closes
  • With several Claude Code processes in the same folder, the Agent board no longer matches processes to the wrong sessions: a freshly opened one shows under idle processes, and one in use is no longer listed as idle
  • Session titles on the Agent board and in the Dynamic Island no longer show slash commands like "/clear"; they use the first real prompt
  • On Windows the Agent board can close idle processes again, and says why when it can't
  • Console windows no longer flash on Windows when switching files
  • On notched Macs the Dynamic Island is no longer pushed below the menu bar
  • With "only local models can read files" on, a chat switched to a cloud model can no longer page through long files, command output or web pages a local model read earlier, and earlier steps of a long task handed to a cloud summary model no longer include that content
  • Deleting a conversation summary or clearing memory no longer lets a summary in progress write the deleted content back

v2.3.4 — Steadier long tasks, sub-task results back in the chat, and forgetting that sticks

2026-11-08

New

  • Settings has a new About page with the version and update check, the homepage, release history, recent updates and feedback; update toggles move into an Update settings dialog
  • Knowledge · Memory · Schedule (sidebar, the input's "+" menu, Ctrl/⌘+Shift+M) now opens in a right-side drawer instead of jumping to Settings
  • /compact accepts what to focus on, e.g. /compact keep the API design
  • The execution trace and /context show the last reply's prompt cache hit rate

Improvements

  • Long tasks no longer fail midway because the context filled up: during a run of tool calls each step is checked against actual usage, older long tool outputs are shortened first and earlier steps are summarized if needed, and a request rejected as too long is retried once with shorter content
  • Once a chat is about halfway full, long tool outputs from older turns keep only their beginning and end, so the original conversation lasts longer before it has to be compacted
  • Auto-compaction uses the context the last reply actually used; summaries are sectioned and followed by recently read or changed files, the latest plan and loaded skills
  • Cheaper and faster: tools offered once in a chat stay offered and earlier reasoning is no longer resent, so the prompt cache breaks less often
  • Unfinished plans get finished: if the turn's plan still has open steps Nomi keeps going or says which step can't be done, and automatic continuation stops when it isn't making real progress
  • Very long tool output is read by its beginning and end first and the middle in pages when needed; command output over the limit keeps its end, so errors and failing tests are no longer cut off
  • Image generation retries twice on temporary errors (network, timeout, rate limit, server error), and only re-downloads when the image was made but the download failed
  • Background Nomi tasks size their context budget from the model's window instead of a fixed 8K

Fixes

  • When a sub-task finishes, the files it changed and the images it generated come back to the chat with the result and Nomi can read them next turn; an image task handed to background Nomi that produced images but no summary no longer counts as failed
  • Background Nomi and knowledge-base answers reply in the language you asked in instead of always Chinese
  • Forgetting memory sticks: deleting a conversation summary also deletes the "About me" entries extracted from it, and they are not extracted again later
  • When a chat switches to a cloud model midway, file contents, command output and web pages read earlier by a local model are checked again against "only local models can read files" instead of being sent along with the history
  • After revoking "Always allow" in Desktop permissions → Privacy, the tab that granted it no longer keeps the sandbox grant on its next turn
  • Messages queued in the sub-task column go only to their own sub-task, in the order sent, and no longer go to another sub-task after switching

v2.3.3 — Agent board, memory guard and a macOS sandbox for coding agents

2026-11-07

New

  • Agent board: "Agents" in the left rail lists Nomi chats, background agents, dispatched and workbench coding agents, and coding-agent sessions you started in a terminal or IDE (read-only) in To do / In progress / Paused / Done; each card shows memory and CPU, and a load indicator in the title bar shows how many are running and their total usage
  • Memory guard: when memory is elevated idle tabs' processes are freed first, and when it is low the coding agents Nomi dispatched and those in the workbench are paused one by one and resumed where they stopped once memory recovers; pause / resume by hand or turn automatic handling off
  • Nomi schedules with the board: when you mention a slow computer, memory or hand off several coding agents, Nomi can check the board and pause or resume the agents it dispatched; while memory is low new hand-offs wait and start once it recovers
  • macOS system sandbox (on by default): coding agents can't read SSH and Git credentials, cloud credentials, key stores, browser data, personal data, .env or private-key files, and can only write to the project folder and their own config and caches; a blocked action shows a card in the chat to allow for this session, always allow (this project only) or deny, and the agent carries on once allowed
  • Sub-tasks open in their own column beside the chat and you can keep talking to them: interject while running, Stop to interrupt, send again when idle, and every later result comes back to the main chat
  • Session details: a title-bar button opens a column beside the chat with the workspace, branch, this session's changes, and its sub-tasks and tasks with their status

Improvements

  • Nomi's fixed per-turn context is halved and prompt caching hits more often: the previous turn's tool calls carry over as-is and long-term memories aren't recalled twice
  • The context ring's breakdown comes from the actual request, listing the system prompt, tool definitions and long-term memory separately
  • A coding agent's working folder must be a project folder, and agents no longer inherit tokens, passwords or cloud keys from your environment; Codex is offline by default and can be allowed online in Coding agents → Permissions
  • Desktop permissions → Privacy adds protected folders, allows environment variables you need, switches the sandbox and revokes "Always allow"

Fixes

  • The sandbox closes several gaps: without a grant agents can't reach ssh-agent or Docker, can't use osascript to have other apps act, can't read publish tokens or shell history, and can't change configuration that runs commands outside the sandbox; write grants open only the smallest scope
  • Coding agents paused when Nomi quit unexpectedly resume on the next start
  • New chat no longer reuses a chat whose first reply is still generating in the background
  • Permanently deleting a chat from Settings → Archived chats stops its in-progress reply first

v2.3.2 — Chats by workspace, a fixed rail, search and branch switching

2026-11-06

New

  • Chats are grouped by workspace: Nomi chats by their workspace and coding-agent tabs by their folder; each folder shows 5 chats and "Show more" adds 5 at a time; folders and the Workspaces / Recent sections can be collapsed
  • A fixed rail on the left: Chats, Tasks and Assets, every coding agent in Workshop mode, and Settings at the bottom; with the chat panel collapsed, hovering Chats or an agent icon pops the chat list out

Improvements

  • The composer grows with its content and the content column narrows to 768; "+", permission, model and voice controls lose their borders and the model moves right next to send
  • The mic and hands-free buttons only show once speech recognition is set up; until then "+" offers "Set up voice input…"
  • The Tasks and Asset library pages sit in the white card, the board uses light-grey lanes, and you get back to chat from the rail or with Esc
  • Scrollbars only appear while you hover the area that scrolls

Fixes

  • Creating a chat reuses the workspace's existing empty chat instead of piling up another one
  • Picking an item from the "+" menu no longer clears the draft you were typing

v2.3.1 — Browser sign-in for remote MCP, rebuilt character rig, adjustable text size

2026-11-06

New

  • Remote (HTTP / SSE) MCP servers can be authorized in the browser via OAuth, with an optional client ID; credentials are stored encrypted and refreshed automatically, and authorization can be cancelled, cleared or redone. Servers with a manual Authorization header work as before
  • Settings → General → Appearance gains a conversation text size (10–20px, default 14px) that only affects message text
  • The official character's Rive animation is rebuilt on a 2.5D skeleton: the rest pose matches the original art, hands reach the face and chest naturally with sleeves following, blinks and bangs move in finer detail, and every motion was redone

Improvements

  • Image themes now use a single mask: blur and opacity apply to the mask only, so the picture no longer zooms or crops; new defaults are 0px blur and 50% mask (existing settings are kept), and the preview matches the real window
  • Content and diffs of file-editing tools (Edit, Write, …) are collapsed by default, keeping long conversations smooth
  • In the input box, Home / End move to the start / end of the line, Shift extends the selection and Ctrl / Command jumps to the start / end of the text

Fixes

  • Models that report thinking without any text now show "Thinking", and the indicator no longer lingers after the reply starts or the turn ends
  • Messages sent while a failed save rewrites the whole conversation are no longer lost, so history after a restart matches what you saw
  • If deleting a conversation can't be written to disk at first, the retry actually saves it, so the deleted conversation doesn't come back after a restart
  • The command allowlist checks dangerous options against the arguments actually passed, so quoted -exec, --output and similar no longer run under a remembered rule
  • Two background tasks starting at once no longer grab the same coding-assistant tab
  • Commits a coding assistant made in a delegation work copy are kept on a nomi/… branch before cleanup instead of being deleted as no work
  • Rescanning Codex / Claude logs older than about two months no longer double-counts calls, tokens and cost
  • The temporary recording used by local speech recognition is readable only by the current user and deleted afterwards

v2.3.0 — Long tasks run through, chat history in the app, smoother and lighter

2026-11-05

New

  • When a turn's tool calls run out and Nomi still has work to do, it continues on its own instead of waiting for "continue"; older long tool outputs are trimmed when it does, so the context doesn't fill up
  • For multi-step work Nomi first writes a plan and updates it step by step, so it knows where it is even after continuing on its own
  • Without a coding assistant installed (or with delegation off), Nomi reads the code, makes small edits, builds and runs tests itself instead of asking you to install one
  • Command confirmations offer "Don't ask again for commands starting with this" (e.g. pnpm test, go test) so they run directly afterwards; review and remove them in Desktop permissions → Tool permissions
  • Double-click the desktop character to open the workbench

Improvements

  • Chat history now lives in the app's data folder and sending a message only appends it instead of rewriting the conversation, so long histories no longer silently stop saving at the browser's ~5 MB limit. Existing conversations are imported once on first launch and checked, with progress shown
  • While a reply streams the chat window no longer redraws everything every frame, so typing and scrolling stay smooth, and the first keystroke in sidebar search no longer stalls
  • The desktop character lowers its frame rate when idle and skips unchanged frames, while talking, blinking and gestures stay smooth
  • Usage tracking uses about half the memory, no longer grows with history, and starts faster
  • Each turn sends fewer tool descriptions to the model: no gesture tools while the desktop character is off, and no ongoing-task tools unless the conversation is about later or recurring work, which saves tokens
  • Diagnostic logs are on by default so a reply's execution trace shows the request sent to the model; records stay on this computer, are capped at 256 MB (oldest removed first), and can be turned off in settings

Fixes

  • Images a coding assistant or CLI saved on this computer (such as the Feishu CLI device-login QR code) now show in the reply instead of "Unsupported image link"
  • When the desktop character sits at the right or left screen edge, its toolbar and speech bubble move to the other side
  • On macOS the desktop character's bubble and toolbar no longer show a misplaced grey halo
  • Continuing on its own now stops when a run has used a lot of tokens or you declined a step, and the reply says why
  • The command allowlist only accepts test, build, check and read-only commands, no longer overrides "confirm each change" or tools set to "always ask", and pauses after outside content was read and files were changed until you confirm a command yourself
  • Failed chat history saves are retried with a one-time notice, and quitting waits for pending saves
  • When later or recurring work isn't recognized, Nomi offers to set it up as an ongoing task

Notes

  • Downgrading to 2.2.0 still shows conversations as of the upgrade (later messages aren't there) and only about the last 2 months of usage; upgrading again brings everything back
  • Saved allowlist rules that no longer qualify are removed

v2.2.0 — Go only, one-click updates, delegation edits the working folder

2026-11-05

New

  • "Restart to update" now installs and relaunches by itself: on macOS the new Nomi.app replaces the old one in place (checking SHA-256, signature, Bundle ID and Team ID) with no dragging, and the DMG opens only when Nomi isn't in a writable location (run from the DMG, quarantined, or a folder without write access); on Windows the installer runs silently and relaunches Nomi. Takes effect for updates after 2.2.0
  • Tasks delegated to a coding assistant edit the working folder directly by default instead of opening a working copy every time; when parallel tasks in one repo touch the same file, the lower-priority one yields
  • A working copy is opened only when a task is based on another branch, and its changes land automatically when done: small changes are copied back to the working folder, large ones are committed to a new nomi/… branch for you to merge; working copies are cleaned up when a task ends, is cancelled or deleted, and leftovers are removed at startup

Improvements

  • The same kind of delegation (same conversation, coding assistant, folder and task type) continues the previous coding-assistant session, so its context and cache carry over: faster and cheaper
  • Delegated sessions are viewed only in Nomi and no longer appear in the sidebar, the running count or the coding assistant's history

Fixes

  • When a delegated coding task fails midway, every change in its working copy is copied back (previously only the first 50 files); if some files can't be copied, the working copy is kept and the result names them
  • With a model mapping on a third-party provider, usage cost uses the public model's "treat as known model" setting instead of counting calls as unpriced
  • Edits made while a provider re-detect runs (name, keys, model settings) are no longer reverted, and a result for an address you have since changed is not applied to the new one
  • After adding the first third-party provider, Nomi's chat model is filled in with the recommended model again
  • If you switch conversations while a message inserted into Nomi's running turn is still being delivered, a failed delivery is no longer moved into the new conversation and sent there
  • Opening a task that has never run no longer fails with "Invalid output of 'tasks.get'"
  • With the English UI, scheduled tasks and proactive check-ins give the model the weekday in English and no longer run sentences together

Notes

  • Electron installers (Nomi-Electron-…) are no longer provided; users on the Electron build update in-app to the Go build, and data is migrated on first launch

v2.1.2 — Keep sending while a turn runs, execution trace, redesigned provider editing

2026-11-04

New

  • Third-party models can be "treated as" a known model: for a relay's renamed model (say Aerith-opus that is really claude-opus), pick the matching known model and context, max output, capabilities, long context and pricing follow it; values you fill in still win
  • Any model can declare a standard window: once set, long context can be turned on per tab from the input bar, and it compacts at the standard window otherwise
  • For Claude-family models declared above 200K, Nomi sends the header long context needs to third-party relays; if a relay rejects it, the request is retried without it and it isn't sent again
  • Keep sending messages while a turn is running without interrupting it: Enter inserts the message into the current turn (handed to the coding assistant or Nomi at its next tool step), Ctrl/⌘+Enter queues it until the turn ends; pending messages show above the composer and can be pulled back, edited or deleted before they're handed over; Esc stops the turn and sends the pending messages at once as one. Claude Code, Codex, Grok and Nomi chats support inserting; Gemini and dsh can only queue for now
  • Type @ in the composer to insert a file or folder path from the workspace (folders end with /)
  • New Execution trace in the workbench: open it from an assistant message's actions to see the turn's timeline and durations, tool call arguments and output, model requests that went through the gateway (with request and response bodies) and the coding assistant process's raw traffic, to help debug tool calls and tasks; works in coding-assistant tabs and Nomi chats

Improvements

  • Provider editing is redesigned: name and Base URL on the top left, keys on the top right; the model list below, with the selected model's settings on the right; rarely used settings fold into More settings
  • Just fill in the Base URL: Nomi detects it when you press Enter or leave the field and fills in each API address; the Base URL is kept as you typed it
  • Each key's API and rate limits live in its own settings; when replacing a key, press Enter to save it without closing the dialog
  • Usage details and the model-quality request list show input, output, cache read and cache write separately
  • Searchable dropdowns such as the model picker have more room around the search box, so they no longer look cramped on Windows
  • Coding-assistant tabs and the provider editor's "treat as" known model now use the same model dropdown as Nomi chats: the same search box, provider tabs, vendor filter, row style and capability hints
  • Opening an image you sent shows the original instead of an enlarged thumbnail; your images and file attachments are right-aligned

Fixes

  • After switching a chat to another provider, requests go to the new one instead of the provider that served the chat before
  • When a coding assistant runs through a third-party provider (Chat API) and the model writes tool calls as <tool_calls>[…]</tool_calls> text, they now run as tool calls instead of showing up as text in the chat
  • Fixed dsh quitting right after launch (patches … must be a top-level YAML array): the empty ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml left behind when an older version removed Nomi's settings is repaired before launch, keeping its comments
  • Detecting a provider retries an API with other models when the first one fails, so APIs such as Responses are no longer reported unavailable on relays with renamed models; saving hand-edited API addresses detects them first so the list shows the right APIs
  • Saving a provider on Windows no longer freezes the window while antivirus briefly holds the file
  • When a task handed to a coding assistant fails, its working copy is removed instead of piling up
  • Files a delegated task changed are told apart by folder, so a same-named file is never previewed or saved in the wrong one
  • Fixed an occasional crash at startup on Linux (the mouse position was read before the app had fully started)
  • An empty "Thought" block no longer appears when the upstream sends only blank reasoning
  • With model-generated titles turned off, new third-party coding-assistant chats no longer make an extra title request

Security

  • A provider link that adds another domain now creates a separate provider, so existing keys are never sent to the new domain
  • A local provider configured with an intranet domain name only fails over to other local providers, never to the cloud
  • Event-triggered tasks keep asking before writes and commands after a retry, resume or rework, just as on the first run

v2.1.1 — Automatic failover, add third-party providers from the web, Light and Dark themes

2026-11-03

New

  • Automatic failover: when the same model is set up on several third-party providers and one returns 429 / 5xx or times out, Nomi retries on the same key after a short wait, then moves to the next provider in list order; while it waits the chat shows "ProvA returned 503; continuing with ProvB", and the reply footer names the provider that actually answered
  • Drag providers on the Models page to set their order (the first is tried first); each row has an on/off switch, and disabled providers are skipped

New

  • A task can be done by Nomi itself or by a coding assistant you have installed (Claude Code, Codex, …); the assistant works in a separate worktree, and changes come back to your workspace only after you accept them
  • Event triggers: a web page or RSS feed changes, GitHub issues / PRs or CI change, new files land in a folder, a coding assistant finishes a turn, the knowledge base updates, or a local MCP tool returns new items; new event tasks only record what they find until you choose to handle them or switch to automatic
  • Outside actions are granted one by one: comment on GitHub issues / PRs, open PRs from nomi/ branches, call tools on your local MCP servers; each action is recorded before it runs, and after a restart Nomi checks whether it went out before asking you
  • Hand work to Nomi in the background: for things that take a while, such as a set of images, a slide deck or a research report, Nomi hands them to a background copy of itself and the chat carries on; the result comes back to the same chat.
